purpose: Teach: 頒布/加味/横行/内職/創始/既得/代用/一掃

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯チラシを地域に頒布します
lines.en: The police will be distributing crime prevention flyers throughout the community.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Even pace. Professional clarity—no flourish. Direct eye contact as if presenting a report.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、地元の意見も対策に加味なさってますね
lines.en: I see. It's good that the police are incorporating local perspectives into your safety efforts.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly formal acknowledgment. Warm undertone—genuine respect for the approach. Slight pause after 'I see' to show he's listening fully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、振り込め詐欺が横行しております
lines.en: Wire fraud scams have been spreading rapidly in the area.
lines.style: Steady, informative tone. Slight weight on the problem. Not alarming, but clearly serious. Measured pace—letting the gravity land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、不正内職斡旋の事件を捜査されてますね
lines.en: Yes, and I understand the police are also investigating fraudulent side-job schemes.
lines.style: Engaged follow-up. Shows he's been paying close attention. Warm but still formal register. Slight nod in his voice—appreciating the thoroughness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、近代警察の創始時の理念を継承します
lines.en: The police remain committed to the principles that founded modern policing.
lines.style: Formal, grounded statement. Deliberate pacing—not rushed. Slight weight on 'committed'—conveying depth rather than routine.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、既得の権限を市民のために使われますね
lines.en: That's clear—the police genuinely use that authority in service of the community.
lines.style: Warm sincerity now. Slight familiarity entering the tone. A real acknowledgment, not a scripted response. Relaxed but still respectful.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不法薬物の代用品にも警戒します
lines.en: We're also vigilant about illegal synthetic drugs and their substitutes.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, thorough. No hesitation. Clean delivery—each phrase carries equal weight. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、犯罪組織を一掃する努力、ありがたいです
lines.en: Thank you. Your efforts to dismantle organized crime really make a difference.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude surfaces. Slower, warmer than earlier lines. A real person speaking now, not just exchanging pleasantries. Quiet conviction underneath.
